lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in semi-regular vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank, with several prominent maxima located centrally posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with primary blobs in the upper dorsal-lateral region, forming a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally across the upper flank, showing a sharp transition from high luminance on the superior edge to shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of smaller circular high-luminance spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
